name: Creation Boston
blurb: Boston stop of Creation's touring Supernatural reunion weekend, with cast autographs, photo ops, panels and a concert.

picks: House band on the Supernatural tour

editions.evidence: Official calendar page: 'Boston, MA Jul. 9-11, 2027 - Creation Boston'; event page: 'BOSTON • JULY 9-11, 2027' and 'VENUE ... Creation Tour '27 in Boston will take place at the Hilton Park Plaza Ho[tel]...'.

notes: Same touring Supernatural-cast brand as Pittsburgh/DC/Austin/Salt Lake City; Jared Padalecki is not on this stop's confirmed list (only Ackles and Collins have headliner slots on the Boston page). Guest photos are duplicated at two sizes; picks cite the larger image of each pair, confirmed by filename (e.g. #32 is loudenSwain.jpg). No separate Boston-specific banner besides a shared stock image, so the cover uses the city-labelled 'ce27-supernatural-tour-2027-boston' banner.
